_comment: WI-3 Discovery + Rescan Scheduler config. Operator-tunable without code change. Loaded defensively by packages/research/scheduling/discovery_scheduler.py; any missing key falls back to the documented default. All thresholds are CONFIG, not hardcoded constants (per WI-3 packet + global guard).

cadences._comment: APScheduler CronTrigger kwargs per discovery job id. Edit hours/days here to retune cadence without touching code.

skip_if_recent._comment: Tier-aware skip-if-recent freshness windows in HOURS. Before enqueueing a wallet for rescan, its last-scan timestamp is compared against the window for its resolved tier; if scanned within the window it is skipped (not re-enqueued). Defaults: locked 6h, candidate 24h, discovered 14d(336h), rest 30d(720h). WP-2 (dossier supersede) is MERGED; sub-daily rescan for locked tier is therefore enabled. Do NOT lower these below WP-2 assumptions without operator sign-off.

tier_priority._comment: Resolved-tier -> scan_queue.priority (1=highest .. 5=lowest). The WI-1 worker drains by (priority, created_at), so this controls drain order: locked -> candidate -> discovered -> rest.

queue_drain._comment: queue-drain job bound. Single-tick bounded drain (one ScanWorker run per fire); NOT a long-lived continuous worker, because the WI-1 ScanWorker documents a single-worker assumption (ClickHouse leases are not atomic CAS). One scheduled tick = one bounded drain = exactly one drainer at a time.

rescan._comment: watchlist-rescan job bounds. Caps how many stale wallets are enqueued per fire to avoid flooding the queue.
